notes.title: Changelog v0.25.0
notes.notes:
[h2]UI[/h2]
- Layout of most Breakdown screens updated to be centered and fit better for both average and wide screens.
- Checkbox to Play tutorials added to the Learning campaign menu. By default all scenario-specific tutorials will be replayed unless unchecked.
- Terms of Service added (English).
- Game save names now auto-generated
- Free labor now updates properly in the New Improvement screen.
- Food Gathering tile selection now properly loads immediately when loading a save.
- Fixed issue where Recruitment screen was empty before an improvement had been built.
- Custom map menu layout adjusted and float inputs replaced with integer sliders.
- Industry breakdown now shows monthly demand and total production.
- Events regarding Settlement starving or Units starving or Freezing will now blink red.
- Reduced default delay before displaying tooltips, and reduced significantly for the Food Gathering tile tooltips (same low delay).
- Very big armies of unit selections now display a page number and button to cycle through all units in the selected units table.
- Progress bars added for countable scenario objectives.
- Units now display a small icon and a circular progress bar when working on a range of different actions which take time, such as: Settling, Prospecting, constructing Fortifications.
- Settlement buttons in the top right Settlements list will now blink red if under attack or starving/rioting.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/0c70779f6df190bf6d75a0be8ae28ef1ffbe032d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/b1fb40b6168a5aa044503b4e54e8229ff98bc2b7.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Settings[/h2]
- Added Reset buttons to all Settings menus
- Max Camera angle reduced from 90 to 60.
- New settings for Ambient occlussion (Graphics) added.
- Fixed so current resolution is displayed in the Graphics settings.
- Fixed an issue where changing the resolution would reset all Graphics settings.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/11ac1b79617a45faf2152a2b3ad1e5c80974e2c6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/0f4ff0bc460816d0db7fa56fba59031c1b698663.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
- The game is now always paused after loading from a save.
- Improvement sleep/active state now properly persists between saves.
- Newly recruited units no longer auto-garrison into the Settlement.
- Armies and units no longer auto-garrison when reaching one of your settlements.
- Difficulty now affects Happiness penalty from Taxation
- Can now launch Amphibian assaults when you have Land military units in the cargo of your ships or fleets.
- Removed starting settlement bonuses based on difficulty (population, improvements).
- Elite Attack Ships added to the barbarian factions, which can ferry land units cargo and are as strong as a Bireme or Trireme.
- Increased strength of Siege units vs Fortifications, particularly when no garrison is present.
- Scoring calculation formulae for most scenarios updated.

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
- Can now Torch settlements after conquering them.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/26156dc115dd6f7f6c03710f388ac380ef9b06d0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/7a777886754b24bf37d3151df14560799be4993d.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/4add68f284b98cb1448c0cb3a424822762c79765.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/c9da670881b8d02ef701ca958ea64c4c0825fca3.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
- Ambient Occlusion added
- Fixed animation speeds of particles, windmills at higher game speeds (6-7)
- Granaries now have faction-specific visuals
- More Gallic units visuals and animations
- Reduced width of the grid lines (toggle with G).
- Units now set up faction-specific tents when idle on the map

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/0bd28b763eea6153e07445c7ccdc36f214c036e2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/58542df2f33bbf1210351e20c146d9548c944d04.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Input[/h2]
- Can now adjust Camera angle with Ctrl + Scroll
- Can now select Settlements by clicking any of their controlled tiles.
- Can now Right click to deselect the currently selected Settlement.
- Sliders for various settings can now be easily adjusted with the Left and Right arrow keys.

[h2]Editor[/h2]
- Several fixes to adding units to settlements, forts and ships in the editor.
- File name filter added to Save/Load file dialogs
- Fixed issue of setting Food supplies in a Settlement.
- Preview icons added to the Events list to see the triggers and actions at a glance
- Added Filters to the Events list based on Difficulty triggers.
- Added icons for Nation traits and tooltips for some.
- Can now set specific Victory images in the Scenario settings mode.
- Fixed an issue where one could paint an invalid attribute to Tiles.
- Can now adjusted the scenario scoring calculation parameters in the Scenario settings.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
- Fixed a few issues with Traders and trading.
- Fixed issues with moving units back and forth between tiles.
- Fixed several images which were failing to display properly.
- Fixed lag issues with very with selections of units/armies.
- Fixed issues with several tutorials.
- Fixed some issues with fading in and out UI.

[h2]Audio[/h2]
- Fixed issue of Tutorial voicelines overlapping other Voice SFX.

[h2]Localization[/h2]
- Raider tutorial objective loc fixed

[h2]Technical[/h2]
- Sliders now work as expected when clicking and dragging, in increments. Previously it was hard to set the maximum values.
- Will be renaming the executable from tata.exe to Iterum.exe. .exe also has icon embedded now.
- Identified and partially addressed memory usage issue noted when creating new maps in the editor repeatedly.
- Texts in UI can now be set to scale down automatically based on available rendering space (width), fixing multiple issues where words or parts of words would not be displayed.
- Fixed text rendering issues with Hindi/Devanagari.
- Fixed shader/graphics issues which would only occur on specific graphics cards.

[h2]Known issues[/h2]
- Localization needed for new additions
- Cannot Garrison units anymore

notes.title: Changelog v0.22.0
notes.notes:
We have done a lot! Not all is mentioned below, but a big portion of it.
We have a new trailer published now as well (with subtitles for a few languages): 
[previewyoutube=CqtJ_wnnvRw;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]UI[/h2]
- Population Breakdown screen updated to show how the stats are used in equation calculations (previously in a simple table).
- Layout of Food production breakdown screen updated.
- New Improvement and New Unit screens updated to part of the main HUD, as well as adapt to both regular screens and wider screen resolutions.
- Positioning and scaling of many tutorials adjusted to work better with both smaller and wide-screen resolutions.
- Moar tooltips added for icons.
- Removed big pause symbol in middle of screen, adjusted how Play/pause button is displayed depending on pause state.
- Number of Free labor in the Settlement now displayed in the New Improvement screen, as that is essential to balance food production vs. too many improvements demanding all your citizens.
- Food production now recalculates immediately when changing food production, so you can see the estimated net production change even when paused. The same prognosis for Happiness trend also updates immediately.
- Entire Settlement button in HUD now blinks red if the settlement is under attack or dying from starvation (No rations).
- New Hot-keys added to: Open Taxation Breakdown (T), Open Settlement Overview UI (E), Open the Log Viewer (L)
- Settling progress now displayed in % when a unit is selected.
- Improved UX when boarding units onto ships, including trying to board parts of armies.
- Year is now displayed in BC/AD.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/e5d928387597d4412cf2533904b38840cbec283b.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/6ad17d66a5ed256633a7c01795a228fed15c0adc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/940ef189cecf35801bfd5112460c61ddeccc7b18.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/1cebb195de257387548aa2ad5a250f2de0bfc07f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/0bf1a7377283f1782b5e4a12065b28ccb0b5c492.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
- In-game Encyclopedia added, accessible from the Main menu and in-game HUD.
- Fixed issues and inconsistencies when queueing new movements mid-movement.
- AI now gathers knowledge of land-masses and bodies of water, and can ship units across waters for sieges/invasions. Separate scouting strategy established for water tiles.
- Water walk movement now disallowed for all land units. Updated pathfinding algorithms, and new events added when units stumble upon Water when exploring the map.
- Military units now automatically capture civilian units, such as Peasants, Traders and Prospectors.
- Building Docks now requires a Woodcutter, and thus access to Woods.
- Collateral losses in Settlement combat/sieges now vary with Difficulty.
- Fixed issue of Armies not fortifying.
- Game speed range updated from 1-5, to 1-7. The new 7 corresponds to the old 5 (very fast).
- Settling units now takes 2 in-game days, previously completed at 'Next day' (0-1 days).
- A diagonal of 2 land tiles, with 2 water tiles on either side is now considered a 'strait', and are slow to traverse, wider than Rivers, but still traversable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/ce46a7eadfa67c961172b6129c57cfdd7529309b.png[/img]

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
- Can now set Max players and Friends-only visibility in the Lobby.
- Can now set per-player Difficulty settings in the Lobby.
- Can now build fortifications with Armies in Multiplayer.
- Pause and Game speed settings now persist between saves. Track max Saves if that is not set to unlimited.
- Fixed issue where faction assignment on start was not working as intended.
- Fixed issues when conquering other Settlements.
- Fixed issues of separating units from Armies.

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
- Iterated how Rivers are generated, and adjusted how Rivers deform the world mesh (sink it down).
- Fixed some rendering issues with some Shadow resolution settings.
- Several Unit animations introduced, such as Idle, Walking, Attacking, Dying, Trading.
- New Particle effects for Smoke added, spawns during Riots, and can be placed in the editor as well.
- Smoothened fog of war fading for ocean shader.
- Softened Autumn transition yellow-out, reduced leaf density and fixed issues with infinite leaves.
- Settlement borders now darken in Fog of War.
- Scaffolding now displayed initially when building Bridges, Supplies Posts and Fortifications.
- Units/Armies now pitch a small tent when Idle on a tile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/074ce96d220df03488a11315def888d374a9cc85.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/8144b7910f6fa4cf8990a26acade508ee85078a5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/b4312253d1fe528a18c344d40afb1c890bfad3ab.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Input[/h2]
- Can now mute tutorials with a single click of Left mouse button.

[h2]Editor[/h2]
- New Editor mode added to paint Visual Props onto the map (F9 hotkey)
- Scriptable Events now have a Repeatable checkbox, if it in its entirety should be repeatable. Should only be used in conjuction with certain triggers, such as on certain events being displayed in the log.
- New Scriptable event Triggers added: Days after event, Build Supplies Post, Difficulty, Build Fortification, 
- New Scriptable actions added for: Toggle Cinematic mode (hides UI, locks game speed, disables most interactions except Pause menu), Take Control of Settlement, Set Follow Camera (to follow a unit, preferably in Cinematic mode), Set Patrol Path (units will move between 2 points, engage enemies 1 tile away if odds are favorable), Add to Population (Free inhabitants or Slaves), Invoke Slave Uprising, 
- Icons added to most Triggers and Action types to ease selection.
- Fixed so Action Despawn Unit works as intended, for both units and armies.
- Fixed Set Attack Target action, now also works for Armies.
- Fixed issues with Build Improvement action.
- Set Victory Objective with empty text now resets the displayed victory objective to the default scenario objectives.
- New Localization editor added to easily work with translation of texts in scenarios.
- Fixed issue where working with several rivers would lag a lot.
- Can now set Unit behavior for single units, such as 'Static', which will make units stand in place and not be moved around by their corresponding AI, to ease scripting desired behavior.
- Can now see previews of Strings in the editor via tooltips, if they exist in the localization file.
- Display error if failing to write a map file, and save immediately when hitting Enter, don't require hitting the Confirm button.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/0f42c20b7b96b531b7441318349d9d1bef9fa069.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/d2ff83ab0d16e3ee16510ddd3c91f0402e10f2af.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/c5b957afc94d13c86551c3f140a4605cfca5b12b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/ae8b363419f04f7939eb62d173467e586332fa39.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
- Fixed issue where initial Camera position would be way to the left instead of centered on the player initial settlement.
- Fixed several gameplay and interaction issues with Fortifications, including their discovery and battles to take them, and save/load.

[h2]Audio[/h2]
- Unit voices now defer to their Faction language, such as Latin for Romans and Gaulish for Gauls.

[h2]Localization[/h2]
- Localization increased to support 15 languages. Initial translations are machine-translated and may contain errors. Please report any faults you notice to us on Discord! We have dedicated language channels. Initial support for: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, French, German, Greek, Hindi, Italian, Irish, Japanese, Latin, Polish, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Ukrainian, Welsh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/bb428ffe0759ce2176c44da9048b87ea194b0a9b.png[/img]

[h2]Technical[/h2]
- Mac build updated, including fixing shadow rendering issues and some size scaling issues for UI/text.
- World mesh cached into map files, which increases file size but increases load speed when entering/loading maps.
- Only load 1 localization at a time, speeding up initial load time.
- OpenAL dependency updated to use a packed dll instead of relying on old OpenAL install, hopefully fixing missing audio issue for some players.
- Support for Blend Shape animations added, enabling animation of units.
- Fixed issues with instanced rendering.
- Integer inputs now by default traverse the Caret with Left and Right arrows (used to increment/decrement)
- Partial support for inputing Unicode text into Text inputs added, including Backspace deleting multi-byte characters.
- Fixed a write out-of-bounds issue which was causing crashes and other erratic behavior.
- Slight optimizations added to text and storage classes.
- Support for vertical 3Slice in UI added.
- Sorting buttons by Name and last edit Date added to File Browser (Save/Load map in Editor)

[h2]Tutorials[/h2]
- New tutorial added to explain selection of units in an Army/unit group.

Thanks to all the testers who stopped by at Närcon Summer 2025 in Linköping last week! We feel we validated that we are going in the right direction with increased playtester satisfaction, but also managed to get a lot of feedback for future improvements. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/c1b1a3fb5809c0573bbedadc8da834f6650cf510.png[/img]

notes.title: Iterum Q1 changes
notes.notes:
After launching the playtest, we are updating more frequently there, so here comes a summary of all changes since the last update in January.

[h1]Gameplay:[/h1]
- Movement speed is now slowed down due to elevation differences, the higher the incline the lower the speed.
- Movement speed is now significantly reduced when crossing rivers.
- Armies automatically capture pacifistic units like Traders 
- Can recruit ships: Bireme, Trireme, Trade ships, Transport ships. All ships have great water movement speed vs land units boarding their own make-shift boats. Transport ships can be used to quickly ferry land units great distances
- Armies can board ships
- Happiness penalty due to Disease deaths now varies with difficulty, and decays over time varying with difficulty
- Can build bridges over Rivers, speeding up movement over rivers
- Archers in armies now get a first-strike in battles, after which their regular melee stats are used
- Attacking from water tile is now penalized.
- AI will now avoid attacking from water files and attack forts around settlement if blocking passage.
- Pathfinding now avoids forts unless targeted explicitly
- When capturing a settlement you can now choose to either annex it, or enslave its citizens and torch it. Captured slaves can be placed in settlements and allocated to various improvement tasks.
- Amass wealth from trade victory condition is now functional
- AI will attempt to take unguarded forts
- Skirmishers and Primitive skirmishers can now hide/camouflage in Woods when standing still
- Traders can now be used to supply armies with food. Traders in the army automatically distribute food from their stockpile to the troops. Finding and taking a Trader on the map carrying food will also work.
- Building fortifications to level 2 will relinquish control from other nation settlements of that tile.
- Building a Market now enables you to buy and sell food and slaves in a settlement. Prices vary over time and on how much is traded.

[h1]UI:[/h1]
- Can now sort units by type in the recruitment screen
- Trade dialog updated to first select trade type, then source settlement
- Fixes when minimizing/maximizing the game window
- Population / Sanitation advisor added to the Improvement construction screen.

[h1]Graphics:[/h1]
- Support for normal maps added
- Anti-aliasing
- Shadows now fall on water too
- Day-and-night cycle for lighting added when playing on game speeds 1 and 2.
- Adjusted how world textures blend together, new setting added
- Ocean shore waves can now be turned on/off in the Graphics Settings
- Updated textures and mesh for table and the board pieces.

[h1]Multiplayer:[/h1]
- Fixes for unit movement, army movement
- Can now play custom multiplayer scenarios
- Can now save and load multiplayer game saves

[h1]Level Editor:[/h1]
- Hot-keys F1-F8 added for the different editor modes
- Mineral icons now hide when in other modes
- Can set Season lengths, if you want longer summers or winters
- New scriptable trigger added for Settlement/Supplies post taken
- New scriptable action added to remove a Settlement/Supplies post
- Can add and remove Fortifications
- New scriptable action to adjust AI nation opinion
- Can now see population of settlement in the inspector panel
- New scriptable trigger for Unit count of specific type
- Fixed so diplomatic treaties can be removed
- You can now set specific unit cold resistance values
- Can now set food cargo of Traders

[h1]Planned:[/h1]
- More multiplayer fixes, as some mechanics don't sync properly still
- More minor game mechanics and adjustments
- More particle effects
- More animations 
- More normal maps where missing
- More scenarios

notes.title: 2025 Early Access Update for Iterum
notes.notes:
This is our first game we are developing and publishing. We thought Early Access would be a good way to go. We released the game in August 2023 in Early Access, when it was still quite early in development – perhaps too early. The state of the game is much better in user experience now, and had we not released earlier then perhaps the Early Access would have been released today instead. We thank our early supporters of Early Access, and wish more will support us as we iterate the product!

In addition to Early Access, we are also setting up Steam Playtest so more users can playtest the game without reaching out to us on Discord.

As the game approaches completion, the final released version of the game will likely be published around Q4 this year (2025), at which point the price of the game and package will be increased. Main website has also been updated: [url=https://iterum.gg/]Iterum.gg[/url]

[h2]A summary of development changes to the game since early access release:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Game intro sequence added
[*]Ocean renderer updated
[*]World map rendered updated
[*]Settlement border renderer updated
[*]UI templates and colors updated
[*]Game name and logo changed
[*]Localization support added, partially localized to 8 languages
[*]Mac OSX ARM 64-bit builds support added
[*]Research game mechanics added and removed
[*]Loyalty of units and settlements and desertion mechanics added
[*]Tutorials added to Learning campaign scenarios
[*]Level editor updated, including scriptable event system
[*]Various new sound effects added
[*]AI and pathfinding logic updated
[*]Several new illustrations added
[*]Outposts added, with partial mechanics shared with Settlements
[*]Army management, movement and combat added
[*]Seasonal change transitions added
[*]Weather particle effects added
[*]Zone weather effects game mechanic added
[*]Food Production Zone selection mechanic added
[*]Fortifications which can be built on open zones mechanic added
[*]Several new UI screens added and UI reviewed many times
[*]Mechanic to upgrade Zones food production added
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog - 0.17.1 - More weather particles and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]User Interface[/h2]
- ZoneInfo tooltip size is now adjusted based on contents
- Selected units/armies are now persisted and re-selected upon loading a game
- Added more fading in/out for UI elements.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
- Particle effects simulation speed now varies with game speed and pause state
- Map-wide snow particles added during winters
- Flooding and rain particles added for zones affected by Floods
- Dust clouds particles added for zones affected by Droughts
- Lightning particles and rain added for zones affected by Storms

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/7c60b8af3d63bab44657b1076453c673b16eb5a7.png[/img]

[h2]Map Editor[/h2]
- Can now set unique unit portraits and name overrides for units

[h2]Technical[/h2]
- Minor performance optimitizations in some UI panels.
- Updated install directory in Steam

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
- Fixed so individual units in armies can be selected again
- Fixed issue where units would join armies incorrectly
- Fixed camera panning movement for scripted actions to be linear

notes.title: Changelog - v0.17.0 Seasonal weather effects and particles
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/03c72bb6677c7b35caf418f4363a7f6729fdc44f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/448f4e66c59427a132187f006ec30e70feb6ad6a.png[/img]

[h2]UI[/h2]
- Zone Food Production buttons now show an animated icon if affected by any weather effects
- Font for 'fancy' texts have been adjusted to use a more easily-read font.
- Animated some parts of the UI slightly
- Improvements to various tutorials.
- Event log moved to bottom right corner.
- Replaced text with icons with a few buttons, such as Menu and Scenario
- Settlement buttons now framed in its own themed 3slice
- Cursor info window on the right removed and replaced with a Zone Info tooltip which appears after hovering over a zone
- Event Log Viewer screen added which can be opened by clicking 'View more' in the Event log. The Event Log Viewer can be used to easily get an overview of all events which have been recorded in your nation's journals, including filtering by event types.
- Food production prediction changed to be a weekly and percentage instead of a number of tonnes.
- Button for selected Settlement is now hidden when it is selected.

[h2]Settings[/h2]
- Default settings of Master volume and SFX volume fixed to work for clean installs.
- Setting for Instanced rendering added should any graphical glitches occur.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
- Adjusting food gathering zones now immediately updates the food production forecast.
- New game mechanic of Zone effects/Weathers introduced, which may impact food production, but also units. Difficulty affects occurrence of weather effects.
[list]
[*]Storms, reduces food production and increases cold damage significantly during winters, also damages units in other seasons.
[*]Blizzards, reduces food production and increase cold significantly damage, only occurs during winters.
[*]Droughts, reduces food production
[*]Floods, reduces food production
[/list] 
- The scenario 'The Defender' is now significantly harder to complete.
- AI now keeps track of previously explored zones, improving scouting efficiency and fixing some erratic behavior
- Cold damage taken reduced in neutral nation territory
- New game mechanic for Upgrading Zone Food production. Every year you can improve one Zone per settlement to tactically increase food production. Zone types benefit in different amounts when upgrading based on its type.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/eaaf9f5dfcb0f34bdea79fee6f5a6d2009c07828.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/e7ecd4211f2c701b3660b288718dcc9c3d56b2fb.png[/img]

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
- Snow particles in the world introduced during winter
- Blizzards appear as snow-storms over affected zones
- Storms appear as rain-storms over affected zones
- Droughts make trees in affected zones change visuals
- Reduced color intensity of nation colors in previously explored fog of war
- Removed the WIP clouds visuals
- Removed the brightly colored stands the units were previously standing on
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/51a0122ef207c415e451675ab187c2de7fd90d57.png[/img]

[h2]Input[/h2]
- New hotkey 'N' added to Settle units.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316154/4dd00c6927cc982f4a50b3fe47d56b1f94258283.png[/img]

[h2]Editor[/h2]
- Creating a new nation will automatically select it.
- New nations default at 500 starting taxes.
- Can now change order of Actions when editing a Scriptable Event
- Can now change order of Events in Scriptable events list
- Icons added in many places (Treaty types, Nations)
- Can now delete nations
- Left and Right mouse button actions for different editor tools now displays in the top bar.
- New scriptable event Actions introduced to dynamically build and spawn armies:
[list]
[*]Add unit to army template
[*]Spawn Army
[/list]
- Scriptable event Trigger 'Day' now has a 'Repeat days' parameter, which when non-0 will make the event trigger again every X days.
- Can now create and delete armies in the map editor.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
- Fixed some issues where camera would zoom out without user input.
- Fixed issue where flowers would sometime remaing on the map after spring
- Fixed an issue where Rewarding units worked when it shouldn't have
- Fixed an issue where players would not get to the Victory screen despite fulfilling all scenario conditions
- Fixed a crash which would occur when entering a multiplayer lobby

[h2]Audio[/h2]
- Reduced frequency of bird sfx

[h2]Technical[/h2]
- UI system now supports animating scale of UI elements easily (scaleAnimation + animationSpeed).
- Fixed font rendering issue affecting single characters at the end of some lines.
- Instanced rendering now applied to several entity groups, improving rendering performance
- Font rendering can now render beautiful mathematical minus-signs when requested so https://www.compart.com/en/unicode/U+2212 
- Full-screen maximizing on Windows now takes into consideration a few more pixels border to avoid white line appearing around the borders.
- Fixed a few pointer-safety issues in thread-message synchronization which likely was causing a few bugs and random crashes previously

[h1]Documentation[/h1]
- Hotkeys page added to wiki: https://iterum.fandom.com/wiki/Hotkeys

[h1]Planned changes[/h1]
- Add lightning strikes to the storms
- Add some dust/wind animation to drought-affected zones
- Add some water particles/animation to flood-affected zones

Also available on official website: https://iterum.gg/changelog-v0-17-0-seasonal-weather-effects-and-particles/

notes.title: Game update v0.14.0
notes.notes:
[h2]UI[/h2]

notes.title: Changelog v0.11.0 - 2024-06-09
notes.notes:
We are rebranding the game from "Time and Time again - a Strategy game" to "Iterum". The core game remains the same, but we will shift our focus to Roman-themed scenarios for initial release, and thus chose this new shorter name. More update details below.


[h2]UI[/h2]

notes.title: Changelog v0.10.0

Hi all! We have released the game soundtrack in major channels! Just search for "Time And Time Again (Game Soundtrack)" to find it in your favorite store, example: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=agvfUzekW_w&list=OLAK5uy_lNJJgBLIYT3hA5kKHKHSfyWjD6qgRfvYs]Youtube[/url], [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/19dRDPCfcGkSwhF6RGxI8f?si=AQ2WqmzFSeK7MJ87UOq8rg]Spotify[/url]. notes.title: Changelog - v0.6.3
notes.notes:
[h1]UI[/h1]
- Happiness breakdown screen now updated with icons for each line, icons on left side.

- Line added in Sanitation breakdown for the new factor of 'Low sanitation over time'.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
- Difficulty can now be selected for the main scenarios.
- Some scenarios you start with more population based on difficulty selection. Defender on Medium is now much easier than it used to be (old settings retained in Hard mode)
- Sanitation simulation of diseases now varies with Difficulty selected.
- Score calculation at victory now takes Difficulty into consideration.
- Low sanitation over longer periods of time will now stack up, reducing your sanitation further. It can never exceed 10% of your sanitation penalty from population size.
- Food rationing at lower levels now affects sanitation.
- Adjusted/reduced how many units pacifistic AI nations recruit.
- Adjusted how AI selects food rationing in their settlements.
- Adjusted how AI recruits units, taking into consideration units in current recruitment queue. It was previously over-queuing recruitments.
- Increased happiness from Standard rations and Extra rations.

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
- Fixed color of settlement flag in multiplayer.

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
